sources.entry: uv - An extremely fast Python version, package and project manager, written in Rust.

summary.one_liner: uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust, covering pip-style installs, projects and lockfiles, scripts, tool running, and Python version management.
summary.what_it_does: uv manages Python project dependencies, lockfiles, and virtual environments, with workspace support. It runs single-file scripts with inline dependency metadata in isolated environments. It runs and installs command-line tools published as Python packages, similar to pipx (via uvx / uv tool). It installs and switches between Python versions, including PyPy. It provides a drop-in pip-compatible interface (uv pip compile, venv, sync) for faster existing workflows. The README claims 10-100x speedups over pip and a global cache for deduplication.
use_cases: replace pip and virtualenv workflows faster
manage Python project dependencies and lockfiles
run a Python script with its dependencies isolated
install or run command-line tools from PyPI
install and pin multiple Python versions
how_to_run: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh  (macOS and Linux, standalone installer)
pip install uv  (or pipx install uv)
uv init example && cd example && uv add ruff
uv run example.py  (run a script with inline metadata)
uvx pycowsay 'hello world!'  (run a tool ephemerally)
notable: Replaces many tools at once: pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, twine, virtualenv
Runs scripts with inline dependency metadata
Installs and manages Python versions, including PyPy
Installable without Rust or Python via curl or pip
caveats: Self-update via 'uv self update' applies only to standalone-installer installs
Speed claims (10-100x faster than pip) are the project's own statements
